in_sanskrit.name: Bhasvan
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'bhask' meaning 'to shine', 'Bhasvan' refers to one who is radiant or shining. It can also be translated as 'sunrise', as the sun rises and illuminates the world, it is a radiant and shining being.

in_hindi.name: भासवन
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, 'Bhasvan' is derived from 'Bhask' (to shine) and 'Van' (forest). It can be interpreted as 'the one who shines in the forest' or 'the shining one in the forest'.

in_tamil.name: பாச்வன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, 'Bhasvan' is derived from 'Pas' (shining) and 'Vanam' (forest). It can be translated as 'the one who shines in the forest' or 'the shining one in the forest'.

in_telugu.name: భాశ్వన
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, 'Bhasvan' is derived from 'Bhasa' (shining) and 'Vanamu' (forest). It can be translated as 'the one who shines in the forest' or 'the shining one in the forest'.

in_marathi.name: Bhasvan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant, Shining Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhasvan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhasvan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhas' meaning 'to shine' and 'van' meaning 'forest'. This name signifies the radiant and shining sun that illuminates the forest. In Hindu mythology, Bhasvan is the name of the Sun God, Surya, who is considered the giver of life and energy.
